BESIX Contracting specializes in construction, infrastructure and marine works, often in contra
data.jd_text:
Since first going into action in 1909, the BESIX Group has over the years grown into a multidisciplinary company with a leading position in its markets: construction, property development and concessions. BESIX Contracting specializes in construction, infrastructure and marine works, often in contracts with a high level of complexity. In Benelux and France, the Group’s regional affiliates BESIX Infra, Belemco, Cobelba, Jacques Delens, Vanhout, Wust and Lux TP ensure a strong presence and a local approach. With Franki Foundations, West Construct, Socogetra, BESIX Environment and Van den Berg, the Group offers specialist niche solutions for the building market like deep foundations, geo\-engineering, road construction, water treatment and cable and pipeline construction.
   

  





 Backed by our experience in our home markets, we have built up strong positions outside Europe. A typical example is the Middle East, where over a 50 year period we have built up an impressive portfolio. This diversification in activities and geography pays off by reducing our risk exposure
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Why This Role Matters**




 The Project Director is responsible for leading the successful delivery of large\-scale marine construction projects (USD 300M\+) across the GCC region. This role carries full accountability for project P\&L, execution strategy, and delivery performance, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
   

  





 The position requires a hands\-on leader from a Tier 1 marine contractor background, with proven experience in delivering complex marine works such as breakwaters, dredging, reclamation, quay walls, and port infrastructure within the GCC.
   

  





**What You’ll Drive**



* Supervise and coordinate activities for the successful completion of the project(s) in accordance with client requirements, organizational policies/procedures, contract terms, and specified time and cost parameters.
* Coach and mentor project managers working under them
* Establish the organizational chart and project processes to ensure the proper functioning of the support team in various sections, in accordance with company policies.
* Address processes malfunctions as needed and motivate staff effectively.
* Coordinate activities on the project(s) among different trades and departments.
* Validate contractual options, whether they are technical, financial, or time related.
* Validate legal matters, with the agreement of the Six Construct legal department.
* Manage contractual and financial follow\-up and budget control.
* Approve all engagements related to the project.
* Conclude supply and sub\-contracts after preparatory work by the support team, including pre\-contract quality and performance audits.
* Engage in social contacts and public relations to benefit the company.
* Coordinate with all third parties, negotiate with contractors, suppliers, and subcontractors throughout all stages of the project life cycle, and participate in handling tenders and contracts.
* Implement project budgets and allocate resources, enforce project standards, conduct technical reviews, manage team.


**Qualifications**

**You’re a Great Fit If You Have**



* Proven experience working with Tier 1 marine contractors
* Minimum 15\-20 years of experience in marine construction
* Currently or recently in a Project Director / Senior Project Manager role
* Strong experience in GCC region (UAE, KSA, Qatar, etc.) is mandatory
* Experienced people and team manager, seeking consensus and demonstrating good listening skills.
* Advanced understanding of contract management.
* Is a natural organizer with deep understanding of process management within an organization.
* Holds deep knowledge of marine construction works, both technically and practically.
* Has the ability to rapidly assess issues, develop alternative solutions, and implement pragmatic strategies.
* Excellent communicator, both internally and externally.
* Demonstrates proficiency in negotiating at a high level and in complex environments.
* Exhibits professionalism, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a results\-oriented approach.
* Holds a high degree of flexibility and adaptability.
* Commercially gifted.
* Fluent in English, and additional European language, such as French or Dutch, is considered an asset.
* Willingness to relocate as required by business needs


**Additional Information**

**Why You’ll Enjoy Working with Us**



* Competitive Benefits
* Positive Workplace Culture
* Opportunity to work with a leading international construction group
* Exposure to large\-scale, high\-impact projects in the Middle East
* Collaborative, diverse, and professional work environment
* Career growth and development opportunities

data.jd_text:
Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



**Job Purpose** 




 To grow and manage large account portfolios and sensitive client relationships for assigned portfolio in the Industrials \& Manufacturing segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates' day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team's objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




  





**Client and Market Analysis** 



* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.



  





**Business Origination** 



* Originate new business opportunities with target clients across relevant banking products in full compliance with applicable internal policies and the Target Market and Risk Acceptance Criteria.
* Obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to close deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Negotiate and develop Term Sheet, mandate letter pitch deck etc. for new transactions in close co\-ordination with product teams. Ability work on financial models, and conduct evaluations to support deal structuring and client presentations. Strong understanding of LMA documentation protocols would be a plus.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Collaborate and work closely with FAB International Branches to increase client wallet share, depth of relationship and X\-sell opportunities with key global client relationships.
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions
* RORAC \[Return on Risk Adjusted Capital] calculation, drafting and submission of CAC note to Capital Allocation Committee in order to meet mandated return thresholds.
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to acceptable parameters set by the
* Bank's management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks to originate new business.
* Maintain up‑to‑date market competitor, regulatory and industry and proactively update account plans as required
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Client Relationship Management** 



* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Group Key Account Plans \[GKAPS] for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* ESG: Liaising with clients for collection of necessary data, info for preparation of ESG rating note in compliance with FAB’s ESG policy \& SOPs and its subsequent renewals at specified intervals.
* Support the timely completion of annual/periodic credit facility reviews the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit policy to balancing earnings with prudent risk management and potential credit downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain internal controls in line with group credit policy i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from client services, CAD (as applicable).
* Achieve high degree of customer satisfaction reflected in NPS score and annual client survey reports.
* Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with new to bank clients



  





**Collaboration** 



* Align with Industrials \& Manufacturing team as well as other product and coverage verticals to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop business proposition strategy, including competitive analysis, targeted client segmentation, service delivery and customer experience model, internal \& external campaigns and ensure alignment with other Products proposition covering Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, and collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 



* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions enabling work is .executed in a controlled, consistent manner and compliant.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis and proactively escalate as appropriate
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit rating of the portfolio on an ongoing basis
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, standard
* Leadership: Act as Role Model for the entire Industrials \& Manufacturing group and demonstrating the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and leadership behaviour.
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to support career progression, skill upgradation and robust short \& long term succession plans.
* Foster a high‑performance culture, driving strong employee engagement, accountability, and a results‑oriented mindset across the team. Encourage ownership and accountability by assigning responsibilities aligned with individual capabilities and development objectives.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Champion Learning and development ,attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure ongoing skill enhancement, development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 Minimum Qualification:
 


* Bachelor’s degree in finance, math or related discipline.
* Master’s degree in business administration is preferred.



  





**Minimum Experience** 



* 15\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.



  





**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes** 



* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or investment banking.
* Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
* Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
* Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
* Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to analyse and research information.
* Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
* Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

 We PLAY BIG

 We are FANATICAL ABOUT PERFORMANCE
   

 We are built on INFINITE THINKING
   

  

 Read more about the Purpose, Beliefs and Guiding Principles that drive us:
   

  

**Our vision for Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging:**

 Our combined energy is fueled by different nationalities, across 6 continents and 24 countries. Our commitment is to celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability.
   

  

**About the job:**
***Kent is looking for a Global IT Security and Compliance Director will be responsible for developing, implementing, and monitoring a strategic, comprehensive enterprise cybersecurity and IT risk management program** 
 . The role will provide the vision and leadership necessary to manage the risk to the Kent and will ensure business alignment, effective governance, systems, integrity, and confidentiality.*
*As a key leader of Kent’s CDIO office reporting directly to the Chief Digital and Information Officer the Global IT Security and Compliance Director, focuses on the governance, risk and compliance aspects of security within the business, The role holder shall further develop and maintain information security policies and processes, ensure appropriate technical cyber defence is in place and manage employee security awareness training. This role serves as a critical resource for employees and leaders regarding information security policy implementation, interpretation, and compliance. The roles assess and prioritises information security and cybersecurity risk across the organization, facilitates compliance with regulatory requirements and information security policies, and develops and reports on information security metrics monthly and maturity models.*
 The role is responsible for reducing information security and cybersecurity risk to Kent by helping to prioritize and drive remediation efforts throughout the organization through the following:
   

  

* Acting as a strategic partner to digital, engineering, and delivery leaders to enable secure innovation while managing enterprise, technology, and operational risk.
* Establishing Cyber Strategy and roadmap
* Establishing and maintaining governance and compliance standards.
* Conducting risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities internally and within vendor or third\-party supplier products.
* Creating, maintaining, communicating, and enforcing information security policies.
* Advising CDIO and senior executive leadership on risk management, including risk mitigation, risk reduction, risk transfer, the risk exception process and residual risk analysis.
* Working with technical teams to ensure adequate cyber protection.
* Measuring and driving maturity improvements, adoption and creating security roadmaps
* Chair Kent’s security council
* Represent as futuristic though leader on secure adoption of new application and AI technologies


  

  

 The role supports the CDIO and advisory external consultancy on the execution of the Information \& Cyber Security Strategy
   

  

**Skills and Responsibilities:**
**Responsibilities:**
**Governance and Compliance**
* Develops and owns overall security strategy.
* Owns and manages process for Incident Detection, Containment, Analysis and Response.
* Evaluates new cybersecurity threats and IT trends and develops effective security controls.
* Oversees development of security awareness programs.
* Evaluates potential security breaches, coordinates response, and recommends corrective actions.
* Define and report on information security metrics.
* Review technology architectures and ensure alignment with security best practices.
* Provide governance and oversight for the secure and responsible adoption of AI technologies, including data privacy and protection, model risk, ethical considerations, and compliance with emerging regulatory expectations.
* Oversee security governance for engineering platforms, automation tools, and system integrations, ensuring appropriate controls, access management, and resilience aligned to Kent’s digital delivery model.
* Provide governance and oversight of secure application development practices, ensuring security is embedded across the full software development lifecycle and modern DevOps delivery models.
* Maintains current knowledge of industry and regulatory trends and developments for the enterprise technology.
* Develops and oversees effective disaster recovery and BCP policies and standards to align with company business continuity management program goals. Coordinates development of implementation plans and procedures to ensure business critical services are recovered in the event of disasters or other incidents, and provides direction, support and in\-house consulting in these areas.
* Develops, implements and maintains a monthly security risk reporting framework for management teams and governance committees.
* Designs and documents technical, administrative, and physical controls to ensure the business demonstrates compliance, ensuring that Kent meets both the requirements and intent of its regulatory and compliance obligations.
* Prepares for and facilitates external audit examinations. Works closely with external auditors and ensures requests are completed timely.
* Creates and manages an information security program.


  

  

**Information Security Risk Assessment**
* Identifies, an
   

 alyses, evaluates, and documents information security risks and controls based on established risk criteria.
* Conducts security risk assessments of planned and installed information systems to identify vulnerabilities and risks. Recommends controls to mitigate security risks identified via risk assessment process.
* Communicates risk findings and recommendations that are clear and actionable by business stakeholders.


  

  

**Security Policy Management and Workforce Training and Awareness**
* Supports workforce security activities including culture, awareness, and training.
* Facilitates collection of evidence to support investigations of possible security or policy violations.

 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented
 **Project Director**

 **Design Division**

 E. This position is responsible for leading the design delivery of large\-scale residential developments. This role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of design \- from concept through detailed design and contruction documentation \- ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest design and technical standards.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;

**Company:** 
 Techne Agency

 Dubai (Managing a UK team) / Hybrid or Remote (with travel when required)

 Full\-Time

 Q3 2026
 



  





**About Techne Agency** 





 Techne is a boutique marketing agency operating at the intersection of brand, content and performance. We specialise in social media, content production, influencer marketing, paid media and website content, delivering integrated strategies across the full customer journey.
 





 We work with premium and luxury brands across hospitality, fashion, beauty and technology, supporting both brand\-building and performance\-driven marketing with a strong track record of results across the UK, UAE and Europe.
 





 Our teams are based across London and Dubai, working with clients on both sides — European and UAE markets. This international footprint allows us to combine cultural relevance, creative execution and performance expertise across multiple markets.
 





 As the agency continues to grow, we are building a senior leadership layer to support this expansion. We are looking for someone who can help shape the future of the business, elevate our standards and play a key role in delivering exceptional work across all clients.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We're looking for a senior operator to lead client delivery across the agency and act as the right hand to the Founder \& CEO.
 





 This is a pivotal role within Techne, offering the opportunity to take ownership of high\-profile client relationships, shape the quality and direction of our work, and build a delivery function designed to scale.
 





 This is not a traditional account management role. You will operate across multiple disciplines — combining strategic oversight, team leadership and hands\-on execution to ensure consistently exceptional output. You'll manage the team, own the day\-to\-day, and be the person who keeps everything moving to a high standard.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Leadership** 



* Own senior client relationships across our European and UAE portfolio, acting as the main point of contact for strategy, performance and escalation
* Lead communication and direction across retainers and projects, ensuring accounts are proactively managed
* Identify and drive growth opportunities within existing accounts and support new business where relevant
* Balance client ambition with operational feasibility — ensuring what gets sold can be delivered



**Delivery \& Standards** 



* Take full ownership of delivery across all accounts, including the transition from new business into execution
* Oversee social media, content production, influencer campaigns, paid performance, and website and editorial content
* Define clear processes and pipelines to deliver each scope item to a high standard
* Challenge output and hold a high bar for creative and strategic quality across all functions
* Understand team strengths and gaps, and step in where needed to support or unblock delivery
* Be comfortable getting hands\-on when required to demonstrate standards or solve execution challenges



**Team Leadership** 



* Manage and develop the social, content, influencer and performance team across London and Dubai
* Set clear expectations and hold the team accountable for performance and delivery
* Provide regular visibility to the Founder \& CEO on team performance, risks and priorities
* Build a culture of ownership, pace and accountability — shifting the team from reactive execution to structured, proactive delivery



**Operations \& Problem Solving** 



* Continuously review workflows, resourcing and delivery structures
* Identify inefficiencies and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Expand and improve the agency's network of vendors, tools and capabilities
* Move the team from ad\-hoc execution to structured, repeatable systems over time



**Growth \& New Business** 



* Support the CEO and the Client Growth Manager on new business pitches through strong strategic, creative and operational input
* Shape proposals, scopes and pricing aligned with both client ambition and delivery capability
* Contribute ideas to improve the agency's offering, positioning and commercial structure



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 7–10 years in a digital marketing agency environment, with at least 2–3 years at a senior account or director level
* Strong working knowledge across social media, content, influencer marketing, paid performance and website content — you don't need to execute everything, but you need to know what good looks like
* Proven experience owning client relationships and driving account growth, not just managing delivery
* Experience managing and developing junior and mid\-level team members
* Commercially aware — strong understanding of scope, resourcing and how to protect margin
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, lean agency — this is not a corporate role
* Experience working with premium or luxury brands — you understand the standard these clients expect
* Based in Dubai with UK market experience, or based in the UK with proven UAE market experience
* Highly solutions\-oriented, with a bias for action and ownership over process



  





**A Note from the Founder** 





 This role is central to the next stage of growth at Techne across London, Dubai and New York.
 





 I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of client delivery, elevate standards across the team and help build a more scalable and structured way of operating — without losing the pace and quality that defines how we work.
 





 This is not a hands\-off or purely strategic role. You'll be expected to lead from the front, bring solutions and step into execution when needed. If you're looking for a highly structured corporate environment, this likely isn't the right fit. If you're motivated by ownership, pace and building something, we should speak.

data.jd_text:
Project London is looking for a Senior Architect to join our Dubai studio as we continue to grow our presence in the UAE.
 



  





 You must be based in Dubai
 



  





 We are a London founded architecture, interiors and project management studio, now bringing the same level of process, detail, commercial rigour and client care to Dubai. Our work is primarily high end private residential, including villas, apartments, bespoke new builds, refurbishments and full interior led transformations.
 



 This is a senior role for someone who can combine strong design judgement with technical competence, site confidence and the ability to manage projects properly from concept through to completion. We are looking for someone who understands that good architecture is not just about beautiful images. It is about clear thinking, proper coordination, robust detailing, buildability, budget awareness and protecting the client’s interests throughout.
 



  





 The Role
 



 The Senior Architect will take responsibility for leading architectural design and technical delivery across a range of private residential projects in Dubai. You will work closely with the Director in Dubai, as well as our interiors, project management and procurement teams, external consultants, contractors, suppliers and client teams.
 



 You will be expected to manage projects with confidence, communicate clearly and bring order to complex design and construction processes. The right person will be comfortable working both in the studio and on site, and will have the experience to spot issues before they become problems.
 



 As Project London UAE grows, this role will offer genuine involvement in shaping how the studio operates, how projects are delivered and how we set standards in the Dubai market.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Lead architectural design packages from early concept through to detailed design and construction information.
 



 Prepare and oversee drawings, specifications, schedules and technical documentation.
 



 Develop layouts, spatial planning, elevations, sections, details and coordinated design packages.
 



 Coordinate with interior designers, MEP consultants, structural engineers, landscape designers, contractors and suppliers.
 



 Review consultant and contractor information to ensure quality, accuracy and alignment with the design intent.
 



 Support authority and developer approval processes, including Emaar, Dubai Municipality, Trakhees and relevant community or master developer requirements.
 



 Attend site meetings and carry out site inspections to review workmanship, progress and compliance with the drawings.
 



 Identify design, technical and coordination risks early and propose practical solutions.
 



 Assist with tender documentation, contractor queries and technical clarifications.
 



 Support project managers with programme, sequencing, cost control and client reporting.
 



 Maintain high standards of drawing presentation, technical accuracy and file organisation.
 



 Represent Project London professionally with clients, consultants and contractors.
 



  





 Requirements
 



 Degree in Architecture or equivalent professional qualification.
 



 Minimum 8 to 10 years’ professional experience, ideally with at least some UAE or GCC project experience.
 



 Strong experience in high end residential architecture.
 



 Excellent technical detailing and construction knowledge.
 



 Confident working across concept design, technical design, tender and construction stages.
 



 Good understanding of Dubai authority, developer and community approval processes.
 



 Strong AutoCAD skills are essential.
 



 Confident on site and comfortable challenging contractors when required.
 



 Strong coordination skills across architecture, interiors, MEP, structure and specialist suppliers.
 



 Excellent written and spoken English.
 



 Highly organised, proactive and commercially aware.
 



 Able to manage multiple workstreams without losing sight of detail.
 



 A calm, professional manner with clients and project teams.
 



  





 The Person
 



 We are looking for someone who takes pride in doing things properly. Someone who can bring design sensitivity, technical rigour and a steady hand to fast moving projects.
 



 You should be comfortable working in a growing studio environment, where everyone contributes and where standards matter. This is not a role for someone who wants to hide behind drawings. We need someone who can think, communicate, coordinate and take responsibility.
 



 You will suit the role if you are:
 



 Practical as well as creative.
 



 Detail focused without losing sight of the bigger picture.
 



 Comfortable with clients, consultants and contractors.
 



 Able to bring calm and clarity to complex situations.
 



 Interested in raising standards in the Dubai residential market.
 



  





 Why Join Project London
 



 This is an exciting opportunity to join Project London UAE at an early stage of its growth, while being backed by an established London studio with a strong reputation in high end residential architecture, interiors and project delivery.
 



 You will work closely with the Director in Dubai and have real involvement in the development of the studio, the way projects are delivered, and the standards we set as we grow. This is not a role where you will disappear into a large corporate structure. You will be close to the decision making, close to the clients and close to the work itself.
 



 We are building something carefully in Dubai, not chasing volume for the sake of it. The aim is to deliver exceptional private residential projects with the same rigour, attention to detail and client care our London clients expect.
 



 For the right person, this is a chance to help shape a growing studio, contribute meaningfully from day one and be part of a business with genuine ambition in the UAE market.
 



  





 Package
 



 Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
 



 Full time role based in Dubai.
 



 Immediate or early start preferred.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 Please send your CV, portfolio and answers to the questions below to:
 



 sm@projectlondon.co.uk
 



 Subject line
 



 Senior Architect Application, Dubai
 



 We would particularly like to see examples of residential projects where you have been involved in technical design, coordination and site delivery, not just concept imagery.
 



  





 Application Questions
 



 Please answer the following four questions when applying. 
 **Anyone who does not answer all four questions will not be considered.** 



1. **Please summarise your relevant experience and explain why you believe you would be a strong fit for this Senior Architect role at Project London UAE. Please include the types of projects you have worked on, your level of responsibility and what you would bring to the team.**
2. **Please describe one completed residential project where you were responsible for taking the design from concept through to technical detailing, tender or site delivery. What was your role, what were the main challenges and what did you personally resolve?**
3. **In Dubai, residential projects often involve tight coordination between architecture, interiors, MEP, structure, authority approvals, contractors and suppliers. Please give an example of where you identified a coordination issue before it became a site problem. How did you handle it?**
4. **Please attach or link to one drawing package, detail sheet or technical example that best represents your own work. Briefly explain what you personally produced and why it demonstrates your suitability for this role.**

**Director \- Business Solutions and Delivery**
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Chief Operations Officer
   

  

**About The Role**
 The role will lead the end\-to\-end execution of strategic projects, programmes and product delivery across the company’s credit\-lending platform and its market deployments. Responsible for ensuring that complex, cross\-functional initiatives are planned and executed with precision, the role works closely with technology, operations, compliance, product, credit risk and partner integrations.
   

  

 The Director will serve as the central point of accountability for roadmap delivery, operational readiness, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices across the business. This is a senior leadership position that requires deep experience in digital lending or financial services delivery, strong technology and operational fluency, and the ability to drive alignment across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-growing, regulated environment.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will demonstrate expertise in managing and coordinating cross\-functional teams, developing comprehensive project plans, allocating resources efficiently, overseeing budgets, and excelling in risk management. He/she must have the skills to effectively manage multiple projects (initiatives, change requests) along with their dependencies and stakeholder engagements. Additionally, the candidate should possess strong analytical skills and the ability to compile and analyze projects (be familiar with Jira, Confluence, MS\-project, MS\-office).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Strategic Delivery \& Programme Leadership:
   

  

* Own the delivery of the enterprise roadmap, ensuring alignment with the COO, Commercial and Technology teams.
* Lead planning, execution and delivery of new projects and major programmes such as new product launches, regulatory changes, platform enhancements, change requests and market expansions.
* Oversee projects across cross\-functional technical and business streams for end\-to\-end delivery, fostering a collaborative work environment, ensuring effective communication and synergy among team members.
* Ensure programmes are fully scoped, resourced, risk\-assessed, and tracked through to completion.
* Provide clear status reporting, dependency management, and decision frameworks to senior leadership.
* Own the prioritisation forum, process and governance alongside resource planning and allocation.
* Customize, utilize and maintain Jira to create dynamic project dashboards, providing real\-time visibility into project status, progress, and key metrics that meet project and stakeholder requirements, incorporating analytical insights.


 Project \& Portfolio Management
   

  

* Develop a structured delivery framework (Agile/Hybrid/Waterfall) suitable for the company’s product and regulatory environment.
* Manage the project portfolio, prioritising initiatives based on strategic value, risk, resource availability, and ROI.
* Ensure robust project governance, documentation, and control processes are in place.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Data, Compliance, and Commercial teams to coordinate programme execution.
* Facilitate cross\-departmental alignment on requirements, timelines, decision points, and resource planning.
* Act as a key escalation point for conflicting priorities, blockers, or delivery risks.


 Operational Readiness \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Ensure that new features, products, and system changes are ready for operational deployment, with adequate testing, training, risk assessment, and support structures.
* Oversee UAT, release management, and change control processes.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery workflows, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.


 Risk, Compliance \& Regulatory Alignment
   

  

* Ensure delivery processes incorporate relevant regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., FCA, consumer credit, data protection, lending rules).
* Maintain strong risk identification, mitigation, and reporting across all delivery initiatives.
* Collaborate with Risk, Banking partners and Compliance teams to ensure regulatory changes are implemented correctly and on time.


 Leadership \& Team Management
   

  

* Lead and mentor a high\-performing team of project managers, functional / delivery leads and PMO staff.
* Build capability within the team through coaching, training, and structured development frameworks.
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and excellence in execution.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelors in Business / Computer science / Engineering / MBA (or equivalent)
* 10\+ years’ experience in project, programme, or delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in financial services, lending, fintech, or credit\-platform environments.
* Strong understanding of the full lending lifecycle (originations, underwriting, credit decisioning, servicing, collections).
* Demonstrated success delivering complex, cross\-functional technology programmes.
* Deep knowledge of project management methodologies and tools (Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, Lean).
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, including at C\-suite and board level.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking capability.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and negotiation skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a highly regulated environment.
* Previous responsibility for PMO leadership, Programme Management or portfolio/project governance.
* Experience with SaaS lending platforms, decision engines, or orchestration tools.
* Certifications such as Prince2, PMP, Agile PM, Scrum Master, or equivalent.
* Exposure to data\-driven decisioning, machine learning credit models, or digital onboarding journeys.


**The Ideal Candidate Is Someone Who**
* Thinks strategically with strong operational discipline.
* Is highly organised with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programmes.
* Leads with presence with the ability to drive clarity in ambiguous environments.
* Has a delivery\-focused mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
* Inspires through collaboration, adopting pragmatic and solutions\-oriented ideas.
* Has high integrity and sound judgement in a regulated context.


**Company Overview**
 Ezra provides B2B digital lending solutions for emerging markets in partnership with mobile and digital wallet operators and financial service providers. Ezra supports 24 operations in 23 countries, across Africa, the Middle East and Asia. Our key office locations are in Nairobi, Kenya and Dubai, UAE.
   

  

 Our flagship products are Airtime Credit Services (ACS), Nano and BNPL.
   

  

* ACS is an airtime or data advance offered to prepaid mobile subscribers at the point of low credit.
* Nano is a micro cash advance offered to mobile wallet users on demand.
* BNPL facilitates payment installments for products and services


 As a FinTech company, our business is entirely technology and data driven, from determining subscriber eligibility, generating relevant offers, managing risk, loan issuance, recovery, optimizing performance and reporting, reconciliation and billing.
   

  

 Each day we process approximately 21M loan requests and 1\.4 TB of data across our markets. This process needs to be robust, reliable and secure.
   

  

 But it doesn’t end there. We’re exploring new ways of using our platform and transactional data to improve our products and develop new product opportunities.

**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction
   

  

* Work closely with Engg, Manufacturing systems manager, supply chain and purchasing on new product industrialisation in a timely manner


 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual
* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness


**Role Context**
 The Plant Director operates within a manufacturing environment serving utility, infrastructure, and industrial customers across the Middle East and export markets. The role leads a multi disciplinary operations organisation, overseeing manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance, and HSE, within a competitive, cost sensitive, and delivery driven market.
   

  

 Reporting to the Manufacturing Operations Director, the role works in close collaboration with regional Sales, Projects, Engineering, Procurement, and corporate functions to align plant capability with customer demand, strategic growth plans, and localisation requirements. The position interfaces regularly with local regulatory and governing bodies in Dubai to ensure compliance, certification, and operational continuity, while balancing operational excellence, people development, and long term business sustainability
   

  

**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree or above in management, electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering or related fields.
* Understand manufacturing business, people management, supply chain management, financial management, quality management, and innovation.
* Possess experience in middle or senior management minimum of 10\-15 years.


**Job\-Specific Skills**

* Values and respects others, Building relationships, Teamwork
* Process Loss Elimination Techniques
* Continuous improvement

data.jd_text:
**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the vision of Dubai’s leadership, to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, and positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many future\-facing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, and more.
 



  





 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programs of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website: www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





**The UAE World Economic Forum’sCentre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution** 




 The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE (C4IR UAE) is a collaboration between the Dubai Future Foundation and the World Economic Forum and is the first global affiliate centre having opened in April 2019\.
 



  





 The UAE Centre is hosted by the Dubai Future Foundation and serves as a global public\-private platform for the collaborative development of technology governance and policy research to offer global visibility to 4IR activities in the UAE. As such, each project portfolio works on a global scale, in collaboration with the World Economic Forum teams and C4IR network, and is tailored to the local ecosystem.
 



  





 Previous and ongoing products of the C4IR have included reports on UAE blockchain use cases and implementation toolkit, the AI procurement toolkit, tokenization and digital assets report and proof of concept, a C\-Suite toolkit for AI. The Centre has also hosted Smart Toys Award and has recently published on the impact of AI on creative economies. All published work is available on www.c4ir.ae
 



  





 The C4IR network is a focal point within the international community for multi\-stakeholder dialogue and concrete cooperation on governance challenges and opportunities presented by advanced technologies from the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR).
 



  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




 The Centre interfaces with senior stakeholders of local and federal government entities across the UAE to support, shape and influence policies associated with 4IR technologies and their impacts on the UAE’s economy and society.
 



  





 The Programme Head will regularly interface with local and regional stakeholders, across the UAE government, along with the CEO and Deputy CEO of the Dubai Future Foundation. She or he will also provide insight and updates to the Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy, and Remote Work Applications. In addition, the Programme Head will manage the Centre’s Steering Committee and interface regularly with the WEF Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution in San Francisco.
 



  





**Programme Head** 




 The C4IR UAE Programme Head will be responsible for leading the Centre, including developing and implementing the annual strategy, and managing the plans, workflows, budgets, and priorities of the Centre. The Programme Head will also play an active role within the DFF structure and will provide insight and expertise when required.
 



  





**Responsibilities \& Reporting Lines** 




 The Programme Head reports directly to the Executive Director of the Dubai Future Institute within DFF.
 



  





 The Programme Head is a complex and articulated position that holds overall responsibility for managing the Centre, including the following:
 



  





 • Ensure the Centre achieves the highest possible visibility and impact through high\-quality products and key activities.
 



 • Ensure the Centre maintains a healthy pipeline of high\-impact products which shall include research reports, policy reports, proof of conceptwork, development of policy proposals, as well as a range of public\-facing engagements.
 



 • Manage internal and external collaborators, including contractors and network members, of varying seniority, to deliver the expected products.
 



 • Sets clear, ambitious targets, activities and workflows for the team. Provides guidance on associated resources required.
 



 • Will support as needed the core activities of DFF.
 



 • Represent the Centre and DFF at internal, national, and international events.
 



  





**Project Management** 




 • You are responsible for leading the full project cycle including managing budgets, project milestones, coaching and developing the team, setting objectives, monitoring and tracking and post\-project reporting.
 



 • You will brainstorm and work with the team to creatively and critically assess ideas, and evaluate processes that could be re\-engineered to identify future projects for delivery.
 



 • You will delegate and assign tasks to the team to ensure the delivery of project deadlines.
 



 • You will need to openly communicate with team members to ensure that all projects are running smoothly and regularly feed back to the Executive Director – Future, Foresight and Imagination on operations and administration.
 



 Third Party Relationships
 



 • You will be responsible for creating a network of expertise, bringing in new connections with experts that will benefit the organisation and building regional and international relationships.
 



 • You will work closely with other departments and entities to understand, analyse their needs and develop strategic content.
 



 • You will work closely with the Communications team to provide high\-level advice on how to activate research, long\-term planning, allocation resources for projects.
 



 • You will be responsible for initiating and maintaining long\-term relationships with other Dubai Future Foundation/Centre partners while actively looking for ways to collaborate supporting them.
 



  





**Why is this role important?** 




 To achieve the biggest impact you will need to affirm the Centre’s role as a convenor of stakeholders in the 4IR space, inform and shape policy, and support the establishment of the centre as a regional beacon for producing high quality research and action, and ensure the Centre is top\-of\-mind among top decision\-makers in Dubai and the UAE.
 



  





**What does the Dubai Future Foundation offer?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with passionate people, support shapers of the future as well as work that has an impact, not only on the organization or the UAE but all of humankind.
 



  





 You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas and innovation.
 



  





 The Centre Head will have the opportunity to participate in / present at international meetings and gain visibility. These may include participation at the WEF annual meeting in Davos, Global Technology Retreats and other engagements.
 



  





**What does the Dubai Future Foundation offer?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with passionate people, support shapers of the future as well as work that has an impact, not only on the organization or the UAE but all of humankind.
 



  





 You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas and innovation.
 



  





 The Centre Head will have the opportunity to participate in / present at international meetings and gain visibility. These may include participation at the WEF annual meeting in Davos, Global Technology Retreats and other engagements.
 



  





**Who we're looking for?** 




 • You will hold an advanced university degree in economics, emerging technologies, public management, or a related field.
 



 • You will have a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience evidenced in research, policy analysis, including experience in national/international/private sector context, with demonstrated capacity for leading significant projects or programmes, including in policy change/innovation.
 



 • You will have a demonstrated ability to plan, organise and conduct technical and policy analysis/research and programme development.
 



 • You will have a thorough knowledge, understanding and experience in 4IR issues, including Artificial Intelligence, blockchain, digital assets, precision medicine, robotics, genomics, etc.
 



 • You should have an excellent network of experts within your field and have strong relationship development capabilities. A strong national and international network relevant to the scope of the Centre will be an important addition.
 



 • You should have a demonstrated history of leading and managing strong performing teams in your previous roles.
 



 • You will be a team player and be generous with sharing your knowledge, supporting the Centre/Dubai Future Foundation team and creating content as well as professional development opportunities.
 



 • You provide evidence of attention to detail, persistence and creativity.
 



 • You are well\-versed in research publication processes.
 



 • You will be fluent in English \& Arabic.

 Identify and mitigate technical risks and implement corrective actions.

**Financial \& Operational Oversight**

**Compliance and Quality**

 Stay updated on industry trends, codes, and emerging technologies.
 











**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.
 



 Minimum 18–20 years of experience in architectural/engineering consultancy (pre and post tender stages).
 



 Proven experience in leading multidisciplinary teams.
 



 Strong knowledge of UAE codes, standards, and authority requirements (e.g., Dubai Municipality, DDA, etc.).
 



 Demonstrated experience in design management and construction supervision.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the Egypt Collections Project from our UAE office. In this role, you will act as the central coordination hub between UAE\-based stakeholders, regional vendors, and multiple Egyptian bank technical teams. Your primary mission is to ensure the successful delivery, integration testing (CIT, SIT, UAT), change management, and production release of the collections platform — while bridging time zones, regulatory environments, and cross\-border working cultures.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Support Egypt Collections Project Activities (from UAE)
 


* Own the end\-to\-end project plan, ensuring alignment with Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) regulations and UAE\-based governance standards.
* Track milestones, risks, dependencies, and budgets across geographically distributed teams.
* Coordinate with in\-country Egypt resources and UAE\-based leadership to maintain project momentum.



 2\. Liaise Between Bank Technical Teams
 


* Act as the primary bridge between Egyptian bank tech teams (Cairo, Alexandria) and UAE\-based integration leads, core banking vendors, and middleware teams.
* Resolve cross\-border technical blockers (e.g., API latency, environment access, data sovereignty issues).
* Facilitate remote technical workshops and maintain clear, bilingual (Arabic/English) communication channels.



 3\. Ensure Delivery \& Plan Testing (CIT, SIT, UAT)
 


* CIT (Component Integration Testing): Coordinate with individual bank tech leads to validate internal component interfaces.
* SIT (System Integration Testing): Design and oversee end\-to\-end test scenarios covering collections workflows across UAE\-hosted and Egypt\-hosted environments.
* UAT (User Acceptance Testing): Engage Egyptian bank business users (collections officers, recovery teams) remotely; define test cases and manage sign\-off.
* Ensure test environments are synchronized and available across both countries.



 4\. Conduct Working Group Meetings
 


* Chair weekly working group sessions with participants from Egypt and the UAE.
* Manage time zone differences effectively (UAE is \+1/\+2 hours ahead of Egypt).
* Distribute bilingual meeting minutes and track action items to closure within 24 hours.



 5\. Provide Periodic Updates to Stakeholders
 


* Prepare weekly dashboards and monthly steering committee presentations for UAE\-based executives and Egypt\-based sponsors.
* Highlight cross\-border risks, testing progress, open change requests, and production readiness.
* Tailor reporting for technical vs. business audiences.



 6\. Manage Change Requests (CRs)
 


* Log, assess impact, and track all CRs (e.g., new collection rules, report formats, integration modifications).
* Facilitate a cross\-border Change Control Board (CCB) with representatives from UAE program management, Egyptian banks, and the vendor.
* Ensure all CRs are approved, documented, and communicated before implementation.



 7\. Manage Production Release
 


* Own the production release checklist: pre\-release testing sign\-off, rollback plan, cutover activities, and post\-release validation.
* Schedule releases to minimize business disruption (typically early Friday UAE time, coordinated with Egyptian bank operations).
* Lead a remote war room from the UAE during and after each release, with Egyptian teams on standby.



  





 Qualifications \& Experience
 



 Essential
 


* Experience: 8–10 years of project management experience in banking technology, with at least 3 years managing cross\-border or multi\-country projects.
* Domain knowledge: Collections systems, credit risk, or payment platforms in a banking environment.
* Testing expertise: Hands\-on experience planning and overseeing CIT, SIT, and UAT cycles.
* Change \& release management: Proven track record managing CRs and production releases in a regulated financial environment.
* Language: Fluent in Arabic and English (written and spoken) – mandatory for stakeholder communication in Egypt and UAE.
* Location: Based in the UAE (Dubai/Abu Dhabi) with ability to work across UAE and Egypt time zones.



  





 Desirable
 


* Familiarity with Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) collections regulations and reporting requirements.
* Experience working with Egyptian bank technology teams or vendors.
* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe Agilist.
* Knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Power BI, and ServiceNow.

We're a Dubai\-based IT solutions studio specialising in structured cabling, enterprise networking, AV integration, CCTV, access control, cybersecurity, and full IT fit\-out delivery.
 



 Our clients include financial institutions, private equity offices, family offices, real estate developers, and professional services firms across the UAE.
 



  





 We operate as a senior\-engineer studio, not a volume contractor.
 



 Every project is led by experienced engineers, and our reputation is built on precision, technical depth, and trusted client relationships.
 



  





 We're hiring a Sales Manager to build our commercial function from the ground up.
 



 You'll design and execute the sales strategy, recruit and develop a team of three Sales Executives, and take full ownership of pipeline growth across project\-based and managed service revenue streams.
 



  





 You'll report directly to the Managing Director and play a central role in shaping the next phase of the company's growth.
 



  





**Expectations** 




 → Build and lead a sales team of three, defining territories, vertical specialisations, and individual KPIs
 



 → Own the full sales cycle — from outbound prospecting through to contract signature
 



 → Develop pipeline across structured cabling, AV, networking, CCTV, access control, and managed IT services
 



 → Implement CRM processes and forecasting disciplines to track pipeline health and conversion
 



 → Drive outbound activity via LinkedIn, email sequences, industry events, and direct engagement
 



 → Build a referral network across fit\-out contractors, MEP consultants, and facilities management companies
 



 → Identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities — turning project wins into recurring managed service contracts
 



 → Represent OPS IT at industry events and networking opportunities across Dubai and Abu Dhabi
 



  





**Your Team** 




 You'll recruit and develop three Sales Executives, each with a defined focus:
 



  





 1\. Projects \& Fit\-Outs — new\-build and fit\-out opportunities through contractor partnerships and construction announcements
 



 2\. Enterprise \& Managed Services — recurring revenue through IT support contracts and network monitoring agreements
 



 3\. Financial Services \& Regulated Sectors — DIFC and ADGM corridors, targeting PE offices, family offices, and regulated entities
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 • 5\+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 2 years leading or managing a sales team
 



 • Track record of hitting revenue targets in the UAE market
 



 • Experience selling IT infrastructure, technology solutions, AV, or related services to commercial clients
 



 • Proven ability to recruit and develop high\-performing salespeople
 



 • Strong understanding of the UAE commercial real estate, construction, and fit\-out landscape
 



 • Proficiency with CRM platforms and sales enablement tools
 



 • Excellent English communication skills — Arabic is a strong advantage
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 • Existing network among facilities managers, IT managers, and procurement teams in the UAE
 



 • Experience selling into regulated sectors (DIFC, ADGM, healthcare)
 



 • Familiarity with Apollo.io, HubSpot, or similar outbound platforms
 



 • Conversational understanding of networking, structured cabling, or AV technologies
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 • Competitive base salary \+ performance\-based commission tied to team revenue
 



 • Company vehicle or vehicle allowance
 



 • Mobile phone
 



 • Medical insurance
 



 • Direct line to the Managing Director — no layers, no bureaucracy

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 At Dyson, we’re driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation—pushing boundaries in engineering, AI, and robotics. Our new Data Intelligence team sits at the heart of this mission: shaping Dyson’s future through data. Here, we blend creativity, precision, and audacity to power intelligent products. We craft data strategies and pipelines that fuel the next generation of connected devices.
   

  

 You’ll work alongside brilliant minds from Dyson global engineering team and external software/hardware partners in an environment built for exploration, discovery, delivery and impact.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Lead Data Intelligence Project Manager, you ensure that every project has the resources it needs to take off, you'll orchestrate data operations that power product development across Dyson’s global teams. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Act as the primary liaison between our external project teams and our internal technical departments (Data Curation and MLOps). You will own the "data logistics" for the entire project lifecycle—from initial storage setup to final delivery of high\-quality training sets.
* You will be the strategic lead for our labelling workforce, managing the balance between our in\-house contractors and 3rd party service providers to ensure we never hit a capacity bottleneck.
* Overseeing data storage setup and maintenance to guarantee security, accessibility, and compliance.
* Maintaining rigorous documentation and workflows that ensure project transparency and repeatability.
* Supporting cross\-functional communication between data teams, contractors, and engineering partners.


**About you**
* 8\+ years in Project or Program Management, with at least 2 years specifically in AI/ML Data Operations or Data Management. You’ve delivered complex projects on time and within scope—often in fast\-changing settings.
* Demonstrated success in managing 3rd party vendors or service providers, including contract negotiation, quality assurance, issue resolution, and ongoing relationship management.
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Knowledge: Strong understanding of how data flows from collection → cleaning → labeling → training → deployment.
* Tooling Familiarity: Experience with labeling platforms (Labelbox, CVAT, Label Studio) and project management tools (Jira, Asana, or Airtable).
* Data Literacy: Basic understanding of data storage architectures (S3, SQL, Snowflake) and data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA).
* Communication: Exceptional "translation" skills—the ability to explain technical MLOps constraints to business stakeholders and vice versa.
* A solid understanding of modern data storage solutions (cloud, on\-premises, hybrid), including principles of data security, privacy, access control, and regulatory compliance.
* Able to translate complex technical requirements into clear actions for both technical and non\-technical audiences. You’re adept at influencing and building consensus.
* Confident interfacing with cross\-functional teams—coordinating with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and external stakeholders to deliver smooth handovers and alignment.
* Well\-versed in project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall). Known for driving continuous improvement, clear documentation, and repeatable processes.
* Thorough, highly organized, and relentless in troubleshooting issues and removing blockers before they impact delivery.
* Proactive, accountable, and comfortable juggling competing priorities. You always keep end goals in focus and balance urgency with quality.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, or Information Technology); higher degree or PMP/Prince2 certification is a plus.


 Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

* Experience of working within a multi\-cultural environment.
* Proven ability to develop strong working relationships and communicate effectively at all levels.


**Desirable**

* Has prepared project related financial reports and reconciliations relating to, project expenses, billing, debt, provisions, and utilization.
* Exposure to preparing statutory returns and financial statements.
* Working knowledge of Oracle EBS, ePBCS, FCCS, Smart View and other IT systems and databases.


**Behavioural Competencies**
****Essential****
* Initiative – able to work independently with minimum supervision, make suggestions on best practice and improving current processes and procedures.

* Strong interpersonal skills – able to develop productive internal working relationships with colleagues at all levels.

 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

* Discretionary bonus program.

 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
