data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates Group, we connect the world through our global hub in Dubai, ensuring our customers always ‘Fly Better.’ As one of the most recognised and admired brands globally, we’re driven by innovation and excellence. Join us as a
 **Project Manager – Transformation Lead (2 Year Temporary Contract** 
 and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our organisation by driving people strategies that empower our global workforce. Experience a fast\-paced, multicultural environment where your expertise in human resources will contribute to building a world\-class employee experience while advancing your own career on a global stage.
   

  

 As the
 **Project Manager – Transformation Lead (2 Year Temporary Contract)** 
 , you will act as the lead for a HR technology transformation programme, owning the end\-to\-end delivery across the business. As the key interface between HR, the business, and technical development teams, you will translate business needs into clear technical requirements, drive alignment, and ensure solutions are fit\-for\-purpose. You will lead the change strategy, ensuring strong stakeholder engagement, effective communication, and a structured approach to implementation, adoption, and embedding of new systems and ways of working to deliver measurable business impact.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Ensure regular review of project delivery performance, contributing to the improvement of systems, procedures, standards, quality and productivity across the department.
* Ensure on time, in scope and within budget delivery of assigned projects, managing projects through all stages to ensure outputs remain aligned to agreed project charters and business objectives.
* Scope and initiate projects in collaboration with internal stakeholders and support functions, agreeing project objectives, milestones, responsibilities and desired outcomes.
* Develop, maintain and manage realistic and properly resourced project plans, ensuring projects are reflected within departmental project registers and planning tools.
* Manage project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle to support smooth implementation, alignment and timely realisation of business benefits.
* Ensure project delivery is achieved within agreed timeframes and budgets, driving efficiencies, cost optimisation and early delivery opportunities wherever possible.
* Ensure functional and system solutions meet agreed business requirements, customer expectations, corporate standards and documented acceptance criteria.
* Identify, assess and manage project risks and issues, implementing agreed mitigation and management strategies prior to implementation.
* Provide timely, accurate and appropriate project reporting and updates to Project Sponsors, stakeholders, steering committees and impacted business areas.
* Develop and coordinate implementation, training and go\-live support plans across relevant departments and business units.
* Analyse, challenge and document business requirements to ensure proposed solutions meet business needs while identifying opportunities for improvement and added value.
* Lead and manage cross\-functional teams, including business users, Emirates Group departments and third\-party service providers, ensuring high quality, cost\-effective and successful project delivery.


 Qualification
   

  

 To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree or Honours in Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience within a PMO, project management or strategic planning function.
* Demonstrated experience managing large cross\-functional projects within a complex organisation.


**You’ll Have An Edge If You Have**
* Commercial and financial acumen, with strong negotiation, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
* In depth knowledge of operating within a large and complex organisation.
* Strong analytical, problem solving, written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrable exposure to project management, change implementation and systems development management.
* Experience using project management tools, application support and business analysis methodologies.


 Emirates Group is an international organisation with employees from over 170 nationalities, we encourage applications from across the globe. Your application journey begins by applying via the Emirates Group Careers website. Please ensure your CV is up to date for our talent acquisition team to review your profile. If you meet the criteria of the role, you will then be invited to complete a HireVue video interview, to share more about your experience and your career aspirations. If you are shortlisted, you will then be invited to interview with our hiring managers. If you are successful, your recruiter will reach out to you with an offer and then our Onboarding team will ensure a smooth transition to your new role at Emirates Group.
   

  

 Salary \& benefits

 Key Responsibilities
 



 Functional Responsibilities

data.jd_text:
**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

data.jd_text:
**Head of Service Operations** 




**MENA Assistance** 




  





 MENA Assistance is a regional authority in roadside, vehicle, and motorist support services, working with major automotive brands across the Middle East and North Africa. We design, manage, and govern service programmes across markets, ensuring reliable, consistent, and high\-quality delivery through controlled operational networks.
 



  





 Our focus is on delivering service performance in environments where operational discipline, control, and judgement matter.
 



  





 We are seeking a Head of Service Operations to lead and safeguard the performance and integrity of service operations across markets. This is a senior operational leadership role focused on service reliability, operational excellence, and disciplined evolution within a live, SLA\-driven environment.
 



  





 The role is suited to an experienced operator who has already held full ownership of service operations in a live environment.
 



  





 In addition to maintaining current operations, the role is responsible for ensuring that service operations expand in capability as new services, programmes, and operational initiatives are introduced, without compromising control or performance.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 




 • Lead end\-to\-end service delivery across live roadside assistance programmes, with full accountability for performance and continuity.
 



 • Ensure service levels, response times, and utilisation targets are consistently achieved and remain stable under operational pressure.
 



 • Ensure the effectiveness of the operational control layer, including dispatch, service coordination, and case management, maintaining control, consistency, and visibility across all service interactions.
 



 • Govern service provider performance to ensure compliance with agreed standards and service levels.
 



 • Lead operational response during service\-critical incidents to ensure continuity and control.
 



 • Ensure operational decisions are made with full awareness of service impact, risk, and client expectations.
 



 • Assess operational readiness for new services, enhancements, and territory launches.
 



 • Lead and operationalise the introduction of new services and operational initiatives, ensuring they are translated into executable and scalable operational processes.
 



 • Ensure that new programmes and service enhancements are implemented without destabilising live operations.
 



 • Drive disciplined improvement, including simplified KPIs, updated SOPs, and the effective use of operational systems, applications, and technologies where they deliver clear operational value.
 



 • Ensure dispatch models, service workflows, and provider network capabilities evolve in line with operational and service requirements.
 



 • Ensure effective use of operational systems, applications, and connected vehicle technologies (including BCall and telematics integrations) to support service delivery and operational control.
 



 • Provide clear, structured, and trusted visibility of service performance, operational risks, and constraints to senior leadership.
 



 • Ensure operational efficiency and cost control across service delivery, maintaining alignment between service performance, provider costs, and operational expenditure.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




 • Proven ownership of service operations performance within SLA\-driven, multi\-market or distributed operational environments.
 



 • Strong understanding of distributed service operations, including coordination between centralised control functions and field execution.
 



 • Proven judgement in escalation management, operational risk, and decision\-making in live service environments.
 



 • Experience operating across multiple markets or regions.
 



 • Experience leading or operationalising the introduction of new services, operational initiatives, or programme expansions within a live operational environment.
 



 • Operational understanding of vehicle systems and mobility environments, with the ability to translate differences in vehicle design (including electric vehicles, internal combustion engines, and evolving automotive technologies) into operational requirements and service delivery models.
 



 • Experience working with operational systems, applications, or connected vehicle technologies, with the ability to translate system capabilities into effective service operations.
 



 • A structured, calm, and reliable leadership style, with a strong sense of accountability.
 



  





 Automotive or mobility sector exposure is preferred. Deep mechanical expertise is not required, but operationally relevant technical understanding is expected.
 



  





 Candidates should be comfortable operating in environments where service performance is visible, measured, and accountable.
 



  





**WHY JOIN** 




 • A senior, trusted role with real ownership and accountability.
 



 • A stable operation with scope to evolve and improve thoughtfully.
 



 • Direct visibility and influence at leadership level.
 



 • Work closely with the Founder \& CEO in a role built on trust, clarity, and operational autonomy.
 



 • An organisation that values reliability, discipline, and long\-term service quality.
 



  





**FINAL NOTE** 




 This role will suit operators who take pride in delivering consistently high service standards and who understand that operational excellence is built through discipline, clarity, and controlled execution over time.
 



  





 It is particularly suited to individuals who can maintain control in live environments while also building the capability required for future services and operational growth.
 








**This role is not suited to candidates stepping into full operational ownership for the first time.**

**JOB TITLE**
 Director, Health and Safety \| MAF Properties \| Head Office
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The role will take a key position within the Project Management Team and serve as an integral member of the Project Management Delivery Team. In addition, the role is expected to contribute to the development of the department’s portfolio\-wide strategic initiatives. The role is primarily focused on Health and Safety leadership, requiring strong collaboration with wider project teams to ensure seamless integration of health and safety within project delivery.
   

  

**ROLE PROFILE**
* Champion Health and Safety strategic initiatives to support the development of best\-practice processes, procedures, controls, and management systems across the department.
* Lead and manage team members’ corporate and project objectives, monitoring progress and providing guidance and mentorship.
* Identify, assess, and manage key Health and Safety risks across departmental operations, project development, and construction activities.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with consultants, contractors, project managers, and key design firms.
* Enhance the department’s and organization’s knowledge and understanding of Health and Safety practices and standards.
* Maintain awareness of regional industry trends, legislative developments, and professional standards, ensuring best practices are embedded in project delivery.
* Develop and maintain Occupational Health and Safety policies, procedures, forms, and guidelines aligned with international standards, including ISO 45001\.
* Participate in or lead post\-tender evaluations to assess compliance with Health and Safety requirements.


**Requirements**
* Master’s degree in health and safety is a plus, Diploma in HSE from a recognized body, such as National Examination Board in Occupational Safety and Health (NEBOSH) or British Safety Council.
* 15\+ years of construction work experience in Health and Safety Management.
* Proven experience in the implementation and management of Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems, including OHSAS 18001 / ISO 45001 frameworks.
* Strong capability in HSE auditing, compliance monitoring, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experienced in implementing and promoting Behavior\-Based Safety (BBS) programs to strengthen safety culture and workforce engagement.
* Willingness to travel internationally or work outside the UAE when required to support project teams.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a dedicated Associate Director to lead Enablement efforts across Client Management teams within the UAE and MENA region. This role plays a pivotal part in championing standardised procedures and best practices to enhance operational excellence and risk management. You will be instrumental in fostering a culture committed to zero operational loss and first\-time right execution, acting as a subject matter expert and advisor.
   

  

**Strategy \& Enablement Standards**
* Lead the consistent implementation of Department Operating Instructions (DOIs) and embed standard work methodologies across client\-facing teams to ensure operational consistency and compliance.
* Promote a collaborative and consultative approach to risk mitigation by engaging with stakeholders to identify and address potential risk issues proactively.
* Drive the development of a transparent and open communication culture with auditors and regulators, ensuring engagement aligns with regulatory expectations.
* Elevate client management capabilities by embedding robust governance frameworks and risk reporting best practices.
* Serve as an expert resource, facilitating a culture focused on precision and operational integrity within the teams.


**Business Collaboration**
* Provide critical support for regulatory inspections and audit inquiries related to client management operations.
* Build and maintain effective cross\-functional relationships with Business Units, Finance, Risk, Technology, and Operations to align objectives and enhance team performance.
* Undertake special projects and responsibilities as assigned by the Line Manager and Country Head, ensuring delivery of agreed outcomes.


**Process Management – Credit Documentation**
* Oversee and execute key credit fulfilment processes, including comprehensive BCA reviews, preparation and validation of facility documentation, and management of security documentation.
* Ensure timely and accurate execution of the Key Control Self\-Assessment (KCSA) and Control Standard Test (CST) processes, maintaining strict adherence to internal control guidelines and deadlines.
* Monitor collateral valuations, document expirations, and ensure the issuance and discharge of credit limits are conducted seamlessly to support business needs.


**Core Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will undertake a wide range of responsibilities designed to support and enhance client management operations and compliance frameworks. Your key duties will include:
   

  

* Strategic Enablement: Lead initiatives to harmonise department operational procedures, ensuring teams consistently adhere to established standards and regulatory guidelines.
* Risk Mitigation: Partner closely with risk and compliance units to implement proactive strategies that identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks within client management processes.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Develop and nurture transparent communication channels with internal and external stakeholders including auditors and regulatory bodies to foster trust and compliance.
* Operational Excellence: Champion a culture of continuous improvement by providing training, guidance and support to Client Management teams aimed at enhancing accuracy, efficiency and first\-time right outputs.
* Credit Documentation Oversight: Manage and execute critical credit documentation tasks, ensuring all legal and procedural standards are met and documentation lifecycle is properly maintained.
* Reporting \& Controls: Oversee the implementation and monitoring of key controls such as KCSA and CST, ensuring timely completion and accurate reporting to uphold governance standards.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Engage proactively with various business units, technology, finance, and operations to streamline workflows, solve complex challenges, and contribute to collective growth.


**About Standard Chartered**
 Standard Chartered is a global banking group with a long\-standing heritage spanning over 170 years. We bring together the agility of a challenger with the strength and stability required to make meaningful impacts worldwide. Our commitment is to improve lives, create sustainable value, and foster innovation in everything we do.
   

  

 At Standard Chartered, our purpose is to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity. Our brand promise, 'Here for Good', reflects our dedication to responsible banking and long\-term client relationships. We're proud to cultivate a workplace where every person’s unique talents are valued and where inclusion is more than a policy – it’s a way of life.
   

  

**Our Core Behaviours Underpin How We Work Together**
* Do the right thing: Act with integrity, courage and accountability putting clients first.
* Never settle: Pursue continuous improvement, innovation, and simplicity.
* Are better together: Foster inclusion, collaboration and mutual respect among diverse teams.


 Join us in shaping a future where finance works for everyone.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

 We Recognise And Value Each Employee’s Contributions And Strive To Provide a Comprehensive Package That Supports Your Professional And Personal Wellbeing. Our Offerings Include
   

  

* Competitive remuneration: Reflecting the responsibilities and markets in which we operate, aligned with our Fair Pay Charter.
* Robust benefits: Core bank contributions towards retirement savings and essential insurances including medical and life cover, tailored voluntarily to local needs.
* Generous leave entitlements: Annual leave, parental leave up to 20 weeks, sabbatical opportunities up to 12 months, and volunteering leave to encourage community engagement.
* Flexible working arrangements: Options that balance office presence and remote work, supporting diverse work styles.
* Wellbeing initiatives: Access to Unmind, a leading digital mental health platform, wellbeing workshops, global Employee Assistance Programmes, and designated mental health first aiders.
* Learning and development: Continuous opportunities for reskilling, upskilling, and career progression through digital, virtual, and in\-person learning platforms.
* Diversity and inclusion: An inclusive culture where unique perspectives are respected, and everyone has the chance to thrive and contribute fully.

data.jd_text:
Binghatti is one of the UAE’s most dynamic and fast\-growing property brands, headquartered in Dubai. We’re known for bold architecture, visionary design and partnerships with global luxury icons such as Bugatti, Mercedes\-Benz and Jacob \& Co. With a portfolio exceeding AED 15 billion across Dubai’s most prestigious developments, Binghatti continues to transform the city’s skyline and set new standards for innovation and excellence in real estate.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced Head of Infrastructure to lead the planning, design, and delivery of large\-scale civil infrastructure and master planning projects. The role requires a strategic leader with strong technical expertise in roads, water, drainage, and utilities infrastructure, combined with proven experience in managing multidisciplinary teams, stakeholders, and project commercial performance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Governance** 



* Provide strategic oversight of civil infrastructure design and delivery across multiple projects.
* Establish and implement design management frameworks, technical standards, and quality assurance processes.
* Align infrastructure delivery with organizational goals and long\-term development strategies.
* Lead risk identification, mitigation, and performance management across projects.



  





**2\. Design Management \& Technical Oversight** 



* Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary design teams (roads, utilities, drainage, transportation).
* Oversee concept, preliminary, and detailed design stages.
* Conduct high\-level technical reviews and resolve complex engineering challenges.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations and international standards.
* Manage approvals with authorities and regulatory bodies.



  





**3\. Project \& Commercial Management** 



* Manage project budgets, cost control, and financial performance.
* Oversee consultant contracts, scope negotiations, and deliverables.
* Support tendering, bid preparation, and resource planning.
* Ensure timely delivery within budget while maintaining quality standards.



  





**4\. Stakeholder \& Client Management** 



* Act as the primary interface with clients, government authorities, and key stakeholders.
* Lead coordination meetings, technical workshops, and executive discussions.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships to support repeat business.



  





**5\. Team Leadership \& Development** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop engineering teams and project managers.
* Manage resource allocation across multiple concurrent projects.
* Promote a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Support recruitment and succession planning.



  





**6\. Business Development** 



* Identify new project opportunities and support market expansion strategies.
* Contribute technical input to proposals and major bids.
* Develop partnerships with consultants and stakeholders.
* Strengthen company positioning through successful project delivery.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (Master’s or PhD preferred).
* Chartered Engineer status or equivalent (e.g., CPEng).
* 10–15\+ years of experience in civil infrastructure projects.
* Strong experience in infrastructure design (roads, drainage, utilities, water systems).
* Proven experience managing large teams and complex infrastructure portfolios.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Strategic Leadership \& Vision
* Infrastructure Design \& Delivery Expertise
* Commercial \& Financial Acumen (P\&L)
* Stakeholder \& Client Management
* Risk \& Governance Management
* Team Leadership \& Organizational Development



  





  





 At Binghatti, we don’t just build properties – we build legacies. You’ll join a team driven by ambition, creativity and excellence, where ideas move fast and every project makes a statement. Here, you’ll work alongside some of the brightest minds in real estate, contributing to iconic developments that define Dubai’s future. If you’re ready to be part of a company that’s shaping history, Binghatti is where your story begins.

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001
+ Integrate Safety by Design principles including arc\-flash mitigation, segregation, and isolation philosophy.
+ Ensure robust documentation control, ISO compliance, and accuracy of as\-built drawings and O\&M manuals.
+ Maintain centralized engineering data repository and knowledge management systems.


**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).** 
****Experience****
* 15–18\+ years of relevant experience in Protection, Automation, Panel, or System Integration Engineering.
* Minimum 5–8 years in a senior engineering leadership or departmental head role.
* Experience handling multi\-million AED EPC or system integration projects is preferred


**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 
  

  

* Protection Engineering
+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
+ SCADA, RTU, IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5 protocols.

* Engineering Tools
+ EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical
+ DIGSI, AcSELerator, EnerVista
+ ETAP / SKM

* Commercial Acumen
+ Strong understanding of technical specifications, BOM costing, value engineering, and project lifecycle

**Closing Date:**

 Based in the United Arab Emirates, this full\-time role offers an opportunity to play a key part in delivering Manchester City Football School programmes while developing your leadership and coaching experience in an international environment. You will support the growth and success of a designated venue, contributing to high\-quality coaching delivery, team development and operational excellence within a dynamic and multicultural setting.
 








**Who We Are** 




 Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football\-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.
 



  





 Our Football Education team delivers programmes across the world, bringing Manchester City’s coaching philosophy to life in diverse environments. In the UAE, our programmes continue to grow, providing opportunities to develop players, support coaches and deliver high\-quality football experiences across multiple venues.
 








**The Role** 




 You will support the delivery and development of a Manchester City Football School venue, helping to ensure programmes are delivered to a consistently high standard. Working closely with the Head Coach, you will contribute to coaching delivery while supporting the development of the wider coaching team and maintaining alignment with Manchester City’s philosophy and methodology.
 



  





 Alongside coaching, you will play an active role in the day\-to\-day management of the venue, supporting operations, administration and communication with players, families and internal stakeholders. You will contribute to planning, reporting and continuous improvement, helping to enhance programme quality and support growth initiatives across the venue.
 



  





 You will also contribute to the wider City Football Middle East team, supporting delivery across programmes and stepping into leadership responsibilities when required. Through your approach, you will help create a positive, professional and high\-performing environment for players and colleagues.
 








**What You’ll Bring** 




 ⚽ FA Level 3 or UEFA B coaching qualification (minimum)
 



 ⚽ Experience delivering coaching sessions within a football environment
 



 ⚽ Ability to support and develop coaches within a team setting
 



 ⚽ Clear communication skills when working with players, parents and colleagues
 



 ⚽ Ability to organise and support operational and administrative tasks
 



 ⚽ Understanding of player development across a range of ages and abilities
 



  





**Why Choose Us** 




 Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 **MultiBank Group**

The role oversees both events holistically, ensuring operational consistency while respecting the specific technical and safety needs of water\-based and wellness\-focused delivery.The role works closely with the appointed mass events delivery agency, Fitness Villages teams, internal stakeholders, and city authorities to ensure safe, high\-quality execution and strong participant experience.

* Oversee all operational workstreams including water safety, venue layouts, programming schedules, participant flow, and logistics.

* Review previous Dubai SUP and Dubai Yoga playbooks, risk logs, and post event reports.

**July**

* Support development and refinement of entertainment, programming, and experiential concepts, ensuring operational feasibility.

**August**

* Coordinate commercial and branding requirements with Partnership Operations.
* Support refinement and finalisation of approved entertainment and programming concepts.
* Ensure authority submissions, approvals, and NOCs are progressing in line with programme timelines.
* Identify, track, and mitigate operational risks and interdependencies across both events.


**September**

* Confirm final safety plans, venue layouts, programming schedules, and contingency measures.
* Ensure entertainment, branding, and activation elements are fully integrated into operational and safety plans.
* Conduct formal readiness and risk review sessions with the delivery agency and key stakeholders.


**October**
* Oversee final preparations and pre\-event readiness activities.
* Manage pre build\-up coordination across water and land\-based venues.
* Ensure operational readiness ahead of the DFC live period.
* Resolve high\-impact issues and manage escalations as required.


**November**
* Lead live operational delivery of Dubai SUP and Dubai Yoga.
* Manage on\-ground command, real\-time issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination.
* Oversee decommissioning, venue reinstatement, and handover to relevant authorities and venue owners.


**December**
* Lead post\-event reporting, operational close\-out, and reconciliation for both events.
* Consolidate agency reports, authority feedback, and operational learnings.
* Document recommendations and formally hand over to the Head ofOperations.

data.jd_text:
The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East. This is a key role within the Middle East team. The successful candidate will bring substantial EA experience, gained within an international Law Firm(s) based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9 00am to 6 00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
   

  




  


  

  

 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
   

  

 Please note that, as part of the recruitment process, successful shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete Numeracy, Comprehension and Prioritisation assessments, which will take approximately 60 minutes in total.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Executive support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This may include but is not limited to the following
   

  

 •Proactively manage the Head of Middle East’s complex and high‑volume diary, including scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, often involving numerous senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
   

  

 •Act as a gatekeeper for the Head of Middle East, triaging meeting requests, queries, issues and complaints, redirecting appropriately while ensuring matters are dealt with effectively and without unnecessary involvement from the Head.
   

  

 •Prepare agendas, attend meetings where the Head of Middle East is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and proactively follow up with action owners to ensure completion within agreed timeframes.
   

  

 •Attend additional meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head of Middle East where appropriate, independently managing follow‑up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East with strategic and commercial decision‑making by proactively preparing briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to ensure decisions are well‑informed.
   

  

 •Anticipate information requirements and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams to ensure relevant input is available in advance of key meetings or decisions.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation
   

  

 •Arrange end‑to‑end complex travel for the Head of Middle East, including multi‑destination international itineraries, coordination of different modes of transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
   

  

 •Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction‑specific requirements.
   

  

 •Provide strategic input into travel planning, designing trips that maximise effectiveness by combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
   

  

 •Liaise extensively with colleagues across offices and business functions to ensure a joined‑up firm approach and maximise the value of each trip.
   

  

 •Remain flexible and responsive, managing last‑minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently when required.
   

  

 •Prepare detailed post‑trip reports summarising meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities identified and agreed next steps, for circulation to relevant internal stakeholders.
   

  

 •Ensure all follow‑up meetings and actions arising from travel are diarised promptly, tracked and progressed to completion.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Marketing / Business Development Support
   

  

 •Manage speaking engagements and thought‑leadership commitments, including tracking article and submission deadlines, coordinating preparatory research, and drafting briefing materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
   

  

 •Arrange and coordinate preparatory and briefing meetings in advance of panels, speaking slots or publications, ensuring the Head of Middle East is fully prepared.

Messe Frankfurt Middle East is a leading trade fair and event organizer based in Dubai, and a subsidiary of Messe Frankfurt GmbH, one of the world’s largest event organizers with a history dating back over 800 years. With a strong regional presence, we organize some of the most successful and recognized B2B exhibitions and conferences across the Middle East, including Automechanika Dubai, Beautyworld Middle East, Intersec, and Light \+ Intelligent Building Middle East. Our events connect global businesses, foster industry innovation, and serve as vital platforms for networking, trade, and knowledge exchange across a range of dynamic sectors.
 



  





 Join the team at Messe Frankfurt Middle East as
 **Head of Marketing** 
 for our
 **Mobility \& Logistics portfolio** 
 , where you’ll lead strategic, insight\-driven marketing initiatives that drive growth, enhance audience engagement, and strengthen the positioning of our events across the region.
 



  





 This role is pivotal in shaping the success and future direction of the Mobility \& Logistics portfolio. You’ll take ownership of the end\-to\-end marketing strategy, working closely with the Portfolio Director and Show Directors to deliver high\-impact, data\-led campaigns. From visitor acquisition to exhibitor engagement, you’ll ensure each event is positioned as a market\-leading platform within its sector.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 



* Lead the overall marketing strategy for the Mobility \& Logistics portfolio, overseeing the planning, execution, and performance of all campaigns from concept to delivery
* Partner closely with the Portfolio Director and Show Directors to develop and deliver integrated, insight\-driven marketing strategies that drive visitor growth, exhibitor engagement, and sponsorship opportunities
* Manage, mentor, and develop a high\-performing marketing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Oversee the visitor and exhibitor marketing budgets, ensuring effective allocation of resources and strong return on investment
* Utilise data, segmentation, and the Marketing Persona Programme to deliver highly targeted and effective campaigns
* Work closely with internal stakeholders, global teams, and external agencies to ensure seamless delivery of campaigns and consistent brand execution
* Ensure all marketing collateral meets the highest quality standards and aligns with Messe Frankfurt’s corporate guidelines
* Track, analyse, and report on campaign performance, continuously optimising strategies based on insights and results
* Engage directly with key clients and partners, supporting commercial objectives including sponsorship and long\-term partnerships



  





**Essential Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
* Minimum 6\+ years’ experience in marketing, ideally within the exhibitions or events industry
* Proven experience in developing and delivering integrated, data\-driven marketing strategies across multiple channels
* Strong leadership experience with a track record of building and developing high\-performing teams
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience working across senior leadership and external partners
* Strong understanding of data, segmentation, persona development, and marketing automation tools
* Experience managing agencies and delivering high\-quality, impactful campaigns
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence and engage diverse audiences

data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommerce with defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the Senior eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 5\+ years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

 At Kerzner, we never settle. Through continued innovation, our team of pioneers push until the next level is achieved, and then to keep going. Our philosophy is simple \- we go above and beyond to Blow Away our Guest and Colleagues. Good enough never is. For us, it is all about perfection and innovation. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
   

  

 Our Colleagues are at the heart of who we are and what we do. With an international team of over 10,000 Colleagues and strong strategic growth on the horizon, we offer unrivalled career opportunities around the world. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Director, Residential Portfolio Management is responsible for the portfolio‑level governance, planning, and setup of branded residential components across Kerzner’s global Private Homes and Branded Residences development pipeline.
   

  

 The role focuses on the pre‑opening residential lifecycle, from early pre‑development and planning through to opening, providing structured management and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The objective is to ensure that all branded residential projects are consistently defined, correctly configured, brand‑aligned, and operationally ready for structured handover to OpCo at opening.
   

  

 The position acts as the residential portfolio authority, establishing and managing residential project stage gates, defining residential requirements and standards, and validating outcomes at key milestones to ensure quality, consistency, and readiness across a growing pipeline of residential projects. The role does not include responsibility for day‑to‑day operations, rental programs, or HOA governance, which sit outside of this position.
   

  

 The role requires a strong background in luxury hospitality‑led residential product, portfolio oversight, and cross‑functional coordination, with the ability to translate brand intent and residential requirements into repeatable, scalable outcomes across multiple projects and geographies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Governance \& Residential Frameworks** 
  

  

* Establish, own, and maintain portfolio‑wide residential frameworks, standards, and setup playbooks for all branded residential and Private Homes projects.
* Define, document, and maintain Kerzner side residential requirements and performance principles to inform the design and delivery of branded residential projects across the portfolio.
* Establish minimum portfolio requirements (not design solutions) covering:
+ Unit mix and typology principles (performance intent and target ranges, not layouts)
+ Residential amenity principles, including owner only vs shared use positioning
+ Arrival, circulation, privacy, and access requirements, expressed as outcomes rather than spatial solutions
+ Back of house and servicing requirements necessary to support efficient future operation and homeowner experience
+ Residential technology readiness criteria, defining capability requirements rather than system design

* Ensure consistent interpretation and application of branded residential standards across all projects and geographies.


**Residential Project Stage Gates (Portfolio Control)** 
  

  

* Establish and manage Residential Project Stage Gates aligned with the wider development lifecycle.
* Define required residential inputs and outputs at each stage, including:
+ Deal feasibility / concept confirmation
+ Concept design
+ Schematic design
+ Design development (residential “red‑flag” review)
+ Design and Build Phase
+ Pre‑opening residential readiness
+ Handover to OpCo

* Act as the Kerzner residential authority at each stage gate by:
+ Validating compliance with portfolio standards and residential requirements
+ Identifying material risks, gaps, or deviations
+ Confirming readiness to progress from a residential perspective

* Maintain a portfolio‑level record of residential stage‑gate reviews, approvals, and deviations
* Present stage gate readiness to all key internal stakeholders.


**Pre‑Development \& Planning (Residential Input)** 
  

  

* Provide residential subject‑matter input during pre‑development and early planning phases of new branded residential opportunities.
* Support Business Development and Design and Construction teams with residential assessments relating to:
+ Brand alignment and positioning
+ High‑level residential scope and feasibility assumptions
+ Unit mix strategy, typologies, and sizing logic
+ Amenity positioning and residential value proposition
+ Preliminary operational and governance implications

* Define early residential product principles to inform project briefs prior to design commencement.
* Identify and mitigate early‑stage risks that could impact:
+ Residential liveability and owner experience
+ Long‑term asset and portfolio value
+ Operational viability and handover readiness

* Ensure residential planning decisions align with a scalable, repeatable portfolio strategy.


**Design \& Project Interface (Residential Input Only)**
* Provide structured residential input to Design and Project teams at defined project milestones.
* Review residential layouts, adjacencies, circulation, and functional planning from an owner, operator readiness, and portfolio perspective.
* Ensure residential requirements and assumptions are clearly documented and integrated into the design process.
* Monitor design evolution to prevent unintended deviations that may negatively affect residential quality or long‑term usability.
* Maintain a collaborative, non‑authoring relationship with Design, respecting design leadership and consultant ownership.


**Brand Compliance \& Residential Product Integrity** 
  

  

* Ensure branded residential standards are interpreted and applied consistently across the portfolio.
* Review key residential elements impacting brand equity and owner experience, including:
+ Finishes intent and durability
+ Amenity positioning and exclusivity
+ Privacy, acoustics, and spatial separation

* Monitor and document residential deviations, concessions, and approved exceptions.
* Provide portfolio‑level insight into recurring issues and lessons learned across projects.


**Residential Operating Model \& Operating Plan Development**
* Define the Residential Operating Model and develop a structured Residential Operating Plan (ROP) for each project during the planning phase
* Ensure the defined residential operating plan is fully supported by design and asset configuration, validating that back‑of‑house layouts, access, storage, plant capacity, service flows, and residential technology capabilities enable efficient, discreet, and brand‑appropriate operation.
* Validate residential operational readiness from a governance perspective, confirming the asset can be realistically operated as intended, that material operational risks, inefficiencies, or cost drivers are identified and mitigated early, and that the project is ready for OpCo acceptance without fundamental re‑planning
* Formally package and transition the Residential Operating Model to OpCo as part of pre‑opening and handover, ensuring clarity of intent, scope, and assumptions.


**Pre‑Opening \& Handover** 
  

  

* Coordinate with OpCo teams in advance of opening to support a smooth transition of responsibility.
* Lead residential readiness activities prior to opening from a portfolio and governance perspective.
* Ensure completion of all residential handover requirements, including obtaining TCO and OC, establishing asset and warranty register frameworks, completing residential handover checklists, and confirming owner move‑in readiness principles.
* Coordinate structured handover of residential assets to:
+ OpCo (operations)
+ Director of Residence

* Formally transition responsibility at opening, retaining oversight only for portfolio‑level tracking, consult level support and continuous improvement.


**Portfolio Reporting \& Stakeholder Coordination** 
  

  

* Maintain strong collaboration with internal and external stakeholders including:
+ Design
+ Projects / Construction
+ Business Development
+ Property Management
+ OpCo

* Provide regular portfolio reporting on:
+ Residential pipeline status
+ Key risks and mitigation actions
+ Stage‑gate progress and readiness

* Support leadership decision‑making with clear, evidence‑based residential insights.


**Explicit Exclusions (Boundary Clarity)**
* No responsibility for residential rental programs or leasing
* No day‑to‑day residential operations or staffing
* No HOA or residential governance management
* No design authorship or consultant management


**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Business, Hospitality Management, Architecture, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 8–10 years’ experience across branded residences, luxury mixed‑use developments, or hospitality‑led residential platforms.
* Strong understanding of branded residential product, owner expectations, and residential lifecycle planning.
* Proven experience working at portfolio level across multiple concurrent projects.
* Ability to influence across Design, Development, Projects, Operations, and Property Management without direct authority.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills with ability to manage complexity across geographies.
* Comfortable operating in an owner‑side, non‑operational, governance‑focused role.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; strong Excel skills preferred.
* Fluent in English; additional languages advantageous.


 Our company is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open\-hearted, innovative, inclusive, and inspiring in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

**About Thunes**

 This role combines hands\-on ownership of key B2B and B2C relationships with direct people management responsibilities, including the oversight, development, and performance management of the regional sales team.  Acting as a key contributor to both execution and strategy, the Director Sales plays a critical role in implementing team\-level sales plans and providing input into the broader regional strategy. The position requires a high level of ownership, cross\-functional collaboration, and the ability to influence stakeholders across levels.
   

  

 Time allocation:
   

  

* 40% leadership
* 30% strategy
* 30% sales involvement


 This is a full\-time position located in Dubai. We offer flexible workplace policies that allow for working remotely 3 days a week and require being in our Dubai office 2 days a week (Wednesdays and Thursdays).
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Team Leadership \& People Management
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of sales professionals, fostering a high\-performance and accountable culture
* Set and manage performance expectations, providing regular feedback and development opportunities
* Serve as a resource and escalation point for team challenges, both internal and client\-related

 Sales Strategy and Execution
   

  

* Drive the execution of sales plans aligned with organizational objectives and member hotel needs
* Contribute to the development of segment, regional, or global strategies by offering market insights and team\-level feedback
* Monitor sales metrics and business trends to identify opportunities, adjust tactics, and optimize account coverage
* Partner with cross\-functional teams (global servicing, marketing, distribution, member relations) to align efforts and maximize impact

 Client Relationship Management

* Represent the organization and its member hotels at key industry events, meetings, and business reviews

 Operations, Reporting, \& Communication
   

  

* Oversee accurate forecasting, reporting, and CRM updates, ensuring visibility into team activity and performance
* Manage team resources and budgets in alignment with strategic goals
* Facilitate regular internal communications, sharing updates, insights, and feedback across teams and leadership
* Contribute to continuous improvement of sales processes, tools, and systems


**Requirements \& Experience**
* Preferred Bachelor’s degree, ideally in Business, Sales, Marketing, or Hospitality.
* 6\+ years of progressive experience in sales, preferably in hospitality, travel, or related industries
* 2\+ years of experience leading and developing high\-performing teams
* Proven knowledge of the MEA luxury travel landscape and its key stakeholders, with an established regional network
* Proven ability to manage strategic accounts and foster long\-term client relationships

* Exceptional communicator with strong executive presence; adept at influencing across cross\-functional teams, client organizations, and senior leadership
* Builds lasting trust and credibility with clients, hotel partners, and internal collaborators through transparency, reliability, and expertise
* Demonstrates sound judgment and professionalism in high\-stakes, client\-facing interactions and strategic discussion
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to oversee multiple workstreams and deliverables while maintaining strategic oversight
* Strong time management and planning skills; able to set clear priorities, guide team execution, and drive results in line with business goals
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word), with the ability to develop strategic presentations and actionable reporting for internal and external stakeholders


**Benefits**
 The Leading Hotels of the World fosters a high\-performance culture and generously rewards its employees for their contributions. Here is just a preview of the benefits we offer:
   

  

* Competitive Salary and benefits package
* Up to $500 for home office setup credit

data.jd_text:
The Business Development Director – P\&AI Division (Middle East). This division\-level leadership role is responsible for driving growth strategy and execution across all P\&AI businesses in the Middle East region. The role works in close partnership with Divisional Marketing, Business Unit Managers, Business Managers, Regional Sales, and Aftermarket teams to accelerate sustainable growth, expand market share, and improve profitability.
   

  

 This position focuses on business development and growth strategy. Marketing communications, branding, and promotional execution are supported through the P\&AI Division Marketing Shared Service and are not owned by this role.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
 Growth Strategy \& Execution
   

  

* Develop and lead execution of the Middle East regional growth strategy aligned with P\&AI divisional priorities.
* Drive execution of critical growth initiatives with measurable impact on orders growth, market penetration, margin expansion, and regional capability development.
* Align divisional, regional, and business\-level priorities to ensure focus on the highest\-value growth opportunities.


 Market \& Opportunity Development
   

  

* Identify, assess, and prioritize strategic growth opportunities at regional and country levels in collaboration with regional and business leadership.
* Lead market analysis, voice\-of\-customer activities, and competitive assessments to support investment decisions and resource allocation.
* Develop and maintain market sizing models, segmentation analysis, and opportunity pipelines to enable data\-driven decision\-making.
* Monitor market, customer, and competitive trends and adjust growth initiatives accordingly.


 Commercial Enablement
   

  

* Partner with Sales and Aftermarket teams to support growth\-focused commercial strategies, including key account development, value\-based pricing approaches, and channel strategy.
* Provide early visibility to regional leadership on upcoming opportunities, including expected scope, timing, and capability requirements.
* Contribute to the creation and continuous improvement of regional and divisional growth playbooks and best practices.
* Cultivate senior‑level customer and partner relationships, establishing top‑to‑top strategic executive engagement to supplement business‑element relationships, and engaging leaders across operators, EPCs, and strategic accounts to shape long‑term growth strategies and influence early‑stage project positioning.
* Coordinate cross‑business project strategies through a structured project pursuit process (e.g., Miller Heiman or equivalent) applied consistently across business elements, ensuring alignment of sales, marketing, engineering, and aftermarket teams to deliver integrated, customer‑centric solutions.


 Portfolio \& Capability Alignment
   

  

* Identify product, solution, and capability gaps relative to Middle East market requirements and competitive dynamics.
* Collaborate with Divisional Marketing and Engineering/R\&D teams to translate market needs into clear business cases and development requirements.
* Ensure growth priorities are clearly communicated to relevant stakeholders to support effective planning and execution.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Act as a connector across P\&AI businesses, promoting collaboration, knowledge sharing, and regional alignment.
* Participate in divisional governance, operating rhythms, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Represent AMETEK P\&AI with customers, partners, and industry organizations in support of growth strategy and market insight.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* Strong knowledge of oil \& gas and process industries, with understanding of Middle East regional market dynamics.
* Demonstrated experience in business development, strategy, or growth leadership within a global, matrixed organization.
* Proven ability to translate strategy into executable initiatives with measurable commercial outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills, including market analysis, financial modeling, and competitive assessment.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and influence skills across cultures and organizational levels.


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or a related field.

data.jd_text:
**Innovation Program Manager (Full\-time, Part\-time or Consultation)** 




  





**About Setup.sa:**




 Setup.sa is a Saudi Consulting firm specializing in softlanding and market entry solutions for international companies. We pride ourselves in being a knowledge house, driven by technology.
 



 Setup.sa was able to leave a mark and build its name in the competitive Saudi market in an exceptionally short time. We are currently one of the fastest growing firms in Saudi Arabia, doubling our number of clients on a monthly basis.
 



  





 As we scale, we still strive to offer operational excellence while changing the way softlanding is done in KSA and raising the bar for the standards of service provision in our sector, pushing the expectations of the clients and the market higher.
 



  





 Being a consulting house, we exist to ensure that the process and journey for foreign companies’ incorporation and operations is done in the easiest and most cost\-efficient way possible.
 



 As this is our North Star, we could build the highest\-value solution in the market and subsequently serve some of the top companies and renowned startups around the world along with multiple government programs. We keep our promises to exceed our clients’ expectations by always going the extra mile, even if the client doesn’t get to know about it.
 



  





 The people working with us expect a lot from themselves and are interested in building solutions that change the way the industry works. They have strong ambitions to achieve exceptional success personally and professionally.
 



  





 Our team is performance\-driven and serious. And we would like to invite you to work with us and become a part of a growing company that has a credible brand name and enjoy an exceptional learning journey.
 



  





**Job Title:**




 Innovation Program Manager
 



  





**Seniority Level:**




 Mid\-senior Level
 



  





**Job Type:**




 Full\-time, Part\-time or Consultation
 



  





**Job Location:**




 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
 



  





**Role Overview:**




  





 The Innovation Program Manager leads the design and execution of incubation, acceleration and venture building programs in Setup.sa, guiding startups across the full journey from idea validation to go\-to\-market. The role focuses on building and managing the entrepreneurship ecosystem by connecting founders with mentors, partners, and investors. It also ensures the successful delivery, growth, and impact of innovation programs aligned with strategic objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  




1. Design, develop, and continuously improve incubation, acceleration and venture building programs covering the full innovation lifecycle from idea validation to go\-to\-market.
2. Identify and attract high\-potential startups and entrepreneurs locally and internationally.
3. Guide startups through key stages including problem validation, solution design, MVP (Minimum Viable Product) development, product\-market fit, and scaling.
4. Oversee the progress of startups within the program, and support founders in developing clear business models, value propositions, and go\-to\-market strategies.
5. Attract and manage relationships with investors, venture capital firms, angel networks, and funding entities.
6. Facilitate investor readiness for startups through pitch coaching, financial modeling guidance, and preparation of investment materials, while organizing demo days, investor meetings, and networking events to connect startups with funding opportunities.
7. Build strategic partnerships with corporates, government entities, and ecosystem players to support program objectives.
8. Establish a strong network of mentors, advisors, and industry experts, ensuring relevant and high\-quality support for startups.
9. Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and innovation practices to continuously enhance the program.
10. Manage program operations including planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and reporting.



  





**Required Qualifications:**




  




* Experience of 8\+ years in innovation management, entrepreneurship and startup ecosystems
* Proven experience in designing and managing incubation, acceleration and venture building programs
* Strong hands\-on experience across the full startup lifecycle from idea stage to scaling and go\-to\-market
* Deep understanding of the Saudi market and its entrepreneurship and innovation ecosystem.
* Experience in attracting and managing funding partners, investors, or venture capital relationships
* Solid experience in stakeholder management across founders, investors, mentors, corporates, and government entities
* Strong understanding of emerging technologies and innovation trends (e.g., AI, fintech, sustainability), along with proficiency in using work management tools (e.g., Notion, Asana)
* Bachelor’s degree
* Preferred: master’s degree (MBA or equivalent)
* Fluent in both Arabic and English

**About The Role**

* Communication \& Escalation Plans: Design, implement, and manage comprehensive communication and escalation plans to ensure timely updates and issue resolution across all levels of the project.

* Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external vendors, ensuring they meet project requirements, timelines, and quality standards. Collaborate with vendors to address any performance issues and ensure smooth project delivery.
